title: UPSC Combined Defence Service Exam II Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: Indian Military Academy (IMA): 100; Indian Naval Academy: 26; Air Force Academy: 32; Officers Training Academy (OTA): 293
qualification: IMA and OTA: Bachelor degree in any stream. Naval Academy: Bachelor degree in Engineering. Air Force Academy: Bachelor degree in any stream with Physics and Mathematics at 10+2 level.
ageLimit: 20 to 24 years as on 01/07/2027. Post-wise age details and relaxation are available in the official notification.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: Rs 200. SC / ST / Female: No fee. Pay through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking or E-Challan.
selectionProcess: Written examination → SSB interview / personality test → Medical examination → Final merit list
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, identity proof, educational certificates and category certificate where applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsconline.nic.in
2. Complete or log in to One Time Registration
3. Open the UPSC CDS II Exam 2026 application link
4. Fill in the required details and upload the documents
5. Pay the examination fee where applicable
6. Review and submit the form, then print the final submission
shortDescription: UPSC CDS II Exam 2026 online form for 451 vacancies. Apply online from 20 May 2026 to 11 June 2026 and check the official notification for post-wise eligibility.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has invited online applications for the Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026. The recruitment has 451 vacancies across IMA, Indian Naval Academy, Air Force Academy and OTA.

Important Dates

  • Application begin: 20/05/2026
  • Last date to apply and pay fee: 11/06/2026
  • Correction date: As per schedule
  • Exam date: 13/09/2026
  • Admit card available: 03/09/2026

Eligibility

  • IMA and OTA: Bachelor degree in any stream.
  • Naval Academy: Bachelor degree in Engineering.
  • Air Force Academy: Bachelor degree in any stream with Physics and Mathematics at 10+2 level.

Vacancy Details

  • Indian Military Academy (IMA): 100
  • Indian Naval Academy: 26
  • Air Force Academy: 32
  • Officers Training Academy (OTA): 293

Read the full notification before applying. Keep your identity proof, educational documents, photograph and signature ready, carefully check the preview before submission, and retain a printout of the final form.
editorNotes: SarkariResult.com is an independent information website and is not a government website. Verify the latest notice on the official UPSC domain before relying on dates or submitting an application.
importantInstructions: Check the official notification for post-wise age limits, medical standards and eligibility. Do not share login OTPs or payment details with anyone.
